name: Meghnad Saha
contribution: Meghnad Saha was an astrophysicist born near Dhaka whose thermal-ionisation equation transformed the study of stellar atmospheres.
context: He also advocated scientific institutions, technical education, and public planning in postcolonial India.
impact: His life links a Bengal education to internationally important science and a sustained belief that knowledge should serve public development.
